description: Authentication security, kill switch activations, circuit breaker state, WebSocket connections, and market feed health.

panels.title: Auth Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of authentication attempts that succeeded.

panels.title: Auth Rate
panels.description: Total authentication attempts per second.

panels.title: Token Reuse Detections
panels.description: Security events: JWT token reuse detected. Any non-zero value = active security incident.

panels.title: Token Refresh Failure Rate
panels.description: Percentage of token refresh attempts that failed.

panels.title: Authentication Attempts by Method & Status
panels.description: Auth attempts per second broken down by authentication method and outcome.

panels.title: Token Reuse Detection Rate
panels.description: Rate of JWT token reuse security events. Any sustained non-zero rate = active replay attack.

panels.title: Kill Switch Activations
panels.description: Total kill switch activations since startup. Each activation halts trading for the affected scope.

panels.title: Circuit Breaker State
panels.description: Circuit breaker state: CLOSED = normal, OPEN = blocking all requests, HALF-OPEN = probing recovery.

panels.title: Kill Switch Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Percentage of kill switch checks served from Redis cache (reduces DB load).

panels.title: CB Rejection Rate
panels.description: Rate of requests rejected by the circuit breaker (only non-zero when CB is OPEN).

panels.title: Kill Switch Activations by Type
panels.description: Kill switch activation events over time by switch_type.

panels.title: Circuit Breaker — Failures / Successes / Rejections
panels.description: Circuit breaker event rates. Sustained failures trigger OPEN state. Successes in HALF-OPEN trigger CLOSED.

panels.title: Active WS Connections
panels.description: Number of active WebSocket connections.

panels.title: WS Message Rate (Sent)
panels.description: WebSocket messages sent per second across all message types.

panels.title: WS Connection Rate
panels.description: New WebSocket connections per second.

panels.title: WS Disconnection Rate
panels.description: WebSocket disconnections per second. High rate may indicate client instability.

panels.title: WebSocket Message Rate — Sent / Received by Type
panels.description: WebSocket message throughput in both directions, broken down by message_type.

panels.title: WebSocket Queue Size by Channel
panels.description: WS outbound queue depth per channel. Growing queue = slow consumer or backpressure buildup.

panels.title: Active Subscriptions
panels.description: Active Upstox market data subscriptions.

panels.title: Tick Discard Rate
panels.description: Rate of market ticks being discarded (duplicates or filtered). High rate indicates filtering issues.

panels.title: Feed Reconnects
panels.description: Total market feed reconnections. Reconnects indicate upstream instability or network issues.

panels.title: Feed Redis Errors
panels.description: Total Redis errors encountered by the market feed service.

panels.title: Market Tick Rate — Received / Emitted / Discarded
panels.description: Market data tick pipeline throughput. Gap between received and emitted = filtered/deduplicated ticks.
